results.title: Salman Khan, Sanjay Dutt's international film '7 Dogs' set to release in India
results.description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], August 10 (ANI): Bollywood stars Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt are set to take their collaboration to the international stage with '7 Dogs' - the action spectacle led by Egyptian superstars Ahmed Ezz and Karim Abdel Aziz.
